Not your wording but while you're here:
```suggestion
				If [param subresources] is [code]false[/code], a [b]shallow[/b] copy is returned: nested resources within subresources are not duplicated and are shared with the original resource (with one exception, see below).
				If [param subresources] is [code]true[/code], a [b]deep[/b] copy is returned: nested subresources are duplicated recursively (with two exceptions, see below). Nested arrays and dictionaries are also duplicated recursively. See [method Array.duplicate] and [method Dictionary.duplicate] for more information.
```
Alternatively, it could be even more identical to Array and Dictionary's but I don't feel particularly strongly about it:
```suggestion
				If [param subresources] is [code]false[/code], a [b]shallow[/b] copy is returned: nested [Array], [Dictionary] and [Resource] properties are not duplicated and are shared with the original resource.
				If [param subresources] is [code]true[/code], a [b]deep[/b] copy is returned: all nested arrays, dictionaries, and subresources are also duplicated (recursively). See also [method Array.duplicate] and [method Dictionary.duplicate].
```
